text:
𝗕𝗔𝗡 𝟭𝟬𝟵/𝟯 𝗔𝗧 𝗟𝗨𝗡𝗖𝗛! 🏏

Centurion Test, day 3: Mulder took two catches-behind wickets, Jansen got Robin (38).
Bangladesh still need 294 to avoid an innings defeat.

Can Shanto & Hridoy resist? 👇
#SAvBAN #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗛 𝟭𝟬𝟵/𝟯 𝗔𝗧 𝗟𝗨𝗡𝗖𝗛! 🏏

👉 Centurion Test ke teesre din South Africa ne 494/7 pe declare kiya
👉 Mulder ne 2 wicket (dono caught behind), Jansen ne Robin (38) ko lbw kiya
👉 Bangladesh (pehli pari 91) ko innings defeat se bachne ke liye abhi 294 run chahiye

Kya Shanto aur Hridoy Bangladesh ko bacha payenge? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #SAvBAN #Cricket
